source.publication: 2025 NJ-1040 Instructions (with GIT-1 & 2 Retirement Income, January 2026, and njit6/njit7 web pages where named)
source.section: Form NJ-1040 lines 20a, 27, 28a, 29: Instr PDF p.22 line 28a ('age 62 or older ... on the last day of the tax year'; Line A joint filers 'enter only the pension income of that spouse'); GIT-1 & 2 p.21 'Only One Spouse Qualifies for Exclusion' example ($74,500); PDF p.8 lines 6-7 (regular and senior 65+ exemptions), PDF p.9 line 13, PDF p.25 line 30, PDF p.27 lines 38-39, PDF p.33 lines 42-43, PDF p.65 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Federal AGI 75,000.00 (spouse 1 private pension 40,000.00 + spouse 2 New Jersey public pension 35,000.00); federal taxable income = 75,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction = 43,500.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 20a pensions 40,000.00 + 35,000.00 = line 27 total income 75,000.00; measure 75,000.00, in the 0-100,000 band (keep share 1). Line 28a: spouse 1 was born 1963-12-31 and is 62 on December 31, 2025, the last day of the tax year, so he qualifies; spouse 2 is 60 and not disabled, so her pension cannot be excluded. Line A = 40,000.00 (his pension only), Line B 100,000.00; lesser = 40,000.00. Line 28b: covered other income 0.00, so 0.00. Line 29 New Jersey gross income = 75,000.00 - 40,000.00 - 0.00 = 35,000.00. Line 30 exemptions (line 13): regular 1,000 x 2 (nobody is 65 or older, so no senior exemption) = 2,000.00; line 38 = 2,000.00 (no other deductions). Line 39/42 taxable income = 35,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 33,000.00. Line 43 tax, rate schedule Table B (joint/head of household/qualifying widow(er)) as bands: 20,000.00 x 0.014 = 280.00 + 13,000.00 x 0.0175 = 227.50 = 507.50. The booklet's Tax Table (taxable income under 100,000) gives 508 for the 33,000-33,050 row (schedule at the midpoint 33,025, rounded); expected keeps the exact schedule result. No credits. State income tax = 507.50. The pension is noncontributory, so the New Jersey taxable amount (line 20a) equals the federal taxable amount and line 20b is empty.
accepted_approximations: Tax Table: for taxable income under 100,000 New Jersey uses its Tax Table, the schedule's tax at each 50-dollar row's midpoint rounded to the dollar; the projection uses the exact schedule.
